instruction: Please take out the 'Glossary' slide from the baseball presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting the 'Glossary' slide from the presentation. Original presentation has 8 slides (slide 6 has title 'Glossary'), so expected count after deletion is 7. Evaluator verifies: (1) slide count decreased to 7 (50% score), (2) 'Glossary' title is no longer present in any slide (50% score). Custom getter reads all slides and extracts slide count and all slide titles.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct slide count (7), 0.5 for 'Glossary' not present in slide titles

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both requirements (slide count reduction to 7 AND absence of 'Glossary' title)
Correct expected values: Expected count of 7 is correct (8 original slides - 1 deleted = 7), 'Glossary' matches the instruction
Logical correctness: Getter extracts the right state (slide count + all slide titles), metric compares correctly with case-insensitive matching
Proper postconfig: Saves the file with Ctrl+S before verification, ensuring changes are persisted
Appropriate partial credit: Scoring gives 50% for count and 50% for title absence, allowing reasonable partial credit scenarios
Edge case handling: Getter handles missing files and failed loads gracefully by returning empty results
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Title extraction relies on shape.name.lower().startswith('title') which is a reasonable python-pptx approach but could miss slides with non-standard title placeholders. This is a practical limitation rather than a logical flaw.

If the original 'Glossary' slide has no detectable title, the metric would pass even without deletion. However, metadata confirms slide 6 has title 'Glossary', so this is not an issue for this specific task.
